page.title: Analysis review
page.compare: Compare this run with another run
page.compareInProgress: This run is still in progress. It can be compared once it has finished.
page.compareUnknownState: This run is in a state this version does not recognize, so it cannot be compared.

nodes.title: Capability nodes
nodes.empty: This run has no capability nodes.

streams.title: Fact streams
streams.empty: This run has no fact streams.

facts.title: Facts
facts.incompleteNote: These results are incomplete. Facts accepted so far are shown, and later results can change them.
facts.continuationRestart: The platform no longer accepts the position in the list, so the list restarted at the first page.
facts.newResults: New results are available for this stream.

range.title: Match-time range
range.hint: Use m:ss or m:ss.SSS, for example 12:30 or 12:30.500.
range.invalidTime: Enter a time as m:ss or m:ss.SSS.
range.negative: The time must not be negative.
range.notIncreasing: The end must be after the start.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.empty: The platform reports no coverage windows for this selection.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the digest and copy it by hand.

states.connectionRequired: A connection is required to review analysis results. SocAlytics shows no analysis data while the platform is not reachable.
states.notFound: This analysis run was not found for this match.
states.notPermitted: You are not permitted to review the analysis of this match.
states.capabilityNotInRun: The chosen capability is not part of this run. Choose one of the run's fact streams.
states.invalidRange: The match-time range is not valid. Use m:ss or m:ss.SSS with a start that is not negative and an end after the start.
states.error: The analysis could not be loaded.
states.inProgress: The analysis is still in progress; no facts yet.
states.incomplete: The analysis is incomplete. Some windows are not accepted.
states.completeWithoutFacts: The analysis is complete and produced no facts.

comparison.title: Compare analysis runs
comparison.intro: Choose two finished analysis runs of this match. Choosing runs does not start, repeat, or cancel any work.
comparison.eligibility: Only runs in a known finished state (completed, partially completed, failed, or cancelled) can be compared. Runs that are still requested or running, or in an unfamiliar state, are not offered.
comparison.formLabel: Choose the two runs to compare
comparison.optionNotLoaded: Run {{runId}} (selected; not in the loaded runs)
comparison.loaded: {{count}} run(s) loaded, {{eligible}} of them finished. Older runs may still exist; load more to see them.
comparison.exhausted: All {{count}} run(s) of this match are loaded.
comparison.insufficient: All runs of this match are loaded, and {{count}} of them can be compared. Two finished runs are needed.
comparison.connectionRequired: A connection is required to compare analysis runs. SocAlytics shows no analysis data while the platform is not reachable.

result.title: Comparison
result.caveat: Each run is shown on its own. Reported counts do not establish that both runs analyzed the same full inputs or that their outputs are equivalent, and a count of zero facts does not mean the analysis is complete.
result.notTerminal: The {{side}} is still in progress and cannot be compared yet.
result.unknownState: The {{side}} is in a state this version does not recognize and cannot be compared.
result.notFound: One of the runs could not be found in this match. Choose the runs again.
result.incompatible: The platform answered with data that does not fit this comparison, so nothing is shown.
result.permanent: This comparison never shows that two runs had equal full inputs or that their outputs mean the same. More or fewer facts, more or less coverage, different provenance, or a newer run say nothing about better or worse quality or performance.

side.plain: Not the current run and not superseded
side.review: Open the detailed review of the {{side}}

streams.title: Fact streams of the {{side}}
streams.empty: This run reported an empty list of fact streams. Nothing was invented for it.

invalid.malformedId: A run identifier in the address is not valid.
invalid.duplicateParameter: The address names a run side more than once.
invalid.unsupportedParameter: The address contains a parameter that the comparison does not support.
invalid.rightWithoutLeft: A right run needs a left run. Choose the left run first.
invalid.identicalIds: Both sides name the same run. Choose two different runs.

pair.title: Pair context
pair.recordingSetSame: Both runs name the same recording set version: {{id}}.
pair.recordingSetDiff: The runs name different recording sets: left {{left}}, right {{right}}. The recording sets differ, so the runs may have analyzed different recordings.
pair.workflowSame: Both runs used the same workflow version: {{workflow}}.
pair.workflowDiff: The runs used different workflows: left {{left}}, right {{right}}. Stream differences below may stem from the workflow.

availability.noExpectedUnits: No expected execution units were reported, so completeness is not established.
availability.noAcceptedResults: No accepted results. Missing units: {{missing}}, failed units: {{failed}}, blocked units: {{blocked}}, skipped units: {{skipped}}.
availability.allSkipped: Every expected unit was skipped; the analysis for this output was skipped, not completed.
availability.incompleteCoverage: Accepted results with incomplete coverage. Missing units: {{missing}}, failed units: {{failed}}, blocked units: {{blocked}}, skipped units: {{skipped}}.
availability.incompleteZero: The accepted results contain no facts, and coverage is incomplete, so absence of facts proves nothing.
availability.completeZeroFacts: Accepted results with complete reported coverage contain zero facts.
availability.incompatible: The reported counts are inconsistent, so no availability is stated.

input.title: Input coverage per dependency
input.notReported: Input coverage was not reported for this node. Missing/null input coverage means not reported, not zero coverage.
input.emptyList: The platform reported an empty dependency list for this node.
input.item: Dependency {{key}}: policy {{policy}}{{fraction}}; accepted {{accepted}}, missing {{missing}}, failed {{failed}}, blocked {{blocked}}, skipped {{skipped}}

align.title: Alignment by capability and scope
align.note: Streams are aligned only when exactly one stream of the same capability and execution scope exists on each side. Alignment is a navigation aid and does not mean the streams are equivalent; reported counts do not show equal full inputs.
align.empty: There are no streams to align.
align.noCounterpart: The other side has no stream of this capability and scope. No counterpart values are shown.
align.ambiguous: More than one stream shares this capability and scope on at least one side, so no pairing was guessed and every stream is shown on its own.
align.noDifferences: No differences in node, versions, output type, profile, image, or model digest.
align.counts: {{side}}: {{facts}} facts; output coverage accepted {{accepted}}, missing {{missing}}, failed {{failed}}, blocked {{blocked}}, skipped {{skipped}}
align.dependenciesNone: Neither side reported dependencies. Unchanged reports do not show equal full input snapshots.
align.dependencyNote: Unchanged reports do not show equal full input snapshots.
align.dependencySame: Dependency {{key}}: same reported policy and counts on both sides.
align.dependencyLeft: Dependency {{key}}: reported only by the left run. {{left}}
align.dependencyRight: Dependency {{key}}: reported only by the right run. {{right}}
align.dependencyNotReported: Input coverage was not reported on at least one side; not reported is not zero coverage.
align.dependencyDetail: policy {{policy}}{{fraction}}; accepted {{accepted}}, missing {{missing}}, failed {{failed}}, blocked {{blocked}}, skipped {{skipped}}
